title: High school e-cigarette use: 2019 peak vs. 2024

source.name: National Youth Tobacco Survey (NYTS)
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: 2019 was the NYTS peak year for high school current e-cigarette use (27.5%); 2024 NYTS (published in MMWR Vol 73 No 41) recorded 7.8%, the lowest level in a decade, following FDA flavor restrictions and enforcement actions against unauthorized e-cigarette products (including Juul).
